thread:
katy_mle: Quick heads-up — ran the first smoke safety + policy sweep on sundial-7b (int3) after yesterday's quant push. High-level notes below, dropping raw numbers and repro steps.

sam_infra: thanks — TL;DR numbers?

katy_mle: TL;DR: latency down ~28% at p50, throughput up ~35% on our dev rig. BUT: small uptick in jailbreak pass rate on our standard red-team set (from 3.2% -> 5.9%). Refusal rate dropped slightly (user-facing soft refusals fewer).

maria_eval: dropping the run summary csv (abridged):
```
model,quant,metric,baseline,new
sundial-7b,fp16,jb_pass_rate,0.032,0.032
sundial-7b,int3,jb_pass_rate,0.032,0.059
sundial-7b,fp16,refusal_rate,0.124,0.122
sundial-7b,int3,avg_latency_ms,120,86
sundial-7b,int3,throughput_rps,45,61
```

leo_prod: do we have per-cohort breakdown? e.g., persona injections vs covert instructions?

maria_eval: yes — split is weird: persona-injection probes stable, but covert-instruction cohort (our COT/chain-of-thought evasions) jumped from 2.7% -> 6.8%. I'll attach the full run to the ticket.

aj_safety: is this consistent across temperature settings? Might be numerical sensitivity causing softer refusals.

katy_mle: ran temp 0.0 / 0.2 / 0.7. The delta is largest at temp 0.0 (deterministic) oddly. At 0.7 the delta shrinks but still present.

sam_infra: could this be kv-cache handling or attention kernel changes in the quant path? Any errors in the logs?

katy_mle: no obvious nan/overflow. Minor trailing token probs in beam edgecases. I pushed a debug build that logs kv cache hashes — see snippet:
```
# debug run
./eval_harness --model sundial-7b-int3 --suite redteam_covert --log-kvhash --out out.json
```

leo_prod: assign a canary roll? We should gate any Dedicated deployments.

katy_mle: agreed — will mark int3 as canary-only and keep fp16 stable for prod.

aj_safety: priority: reproduce locally with exact quant config used in nightly (per-channel quantize params). Maria, can you share quant config?

maria_eval: shared in channel: QCONFIG v3 — asymmetric per-layer group, 5-bit mantissa folding, cross-layer bias correction on. I'll paste config to the ticket.

safety-bot: Automated safety run finished for thread 5256789012. Findings: high-confidence jailbreaks increased in category 'conditional instruction' (6.8% pass rate), flagged 24 high-severity outputs for review. Full artifacts: s3://redwood-inference/sundial/5256789012/artifacts.tar.gz

sam_infra: can we run an A/B with controlled prompt filters (e.g., add refusal scaffolding prompt) to measure effect size?

katy_mle: yes — plan: 1) short-term: add refusal scaffolding as a prompt prefix for int3 canary; 2) medium: run quant re-calibration with bias-corr off to test sensitivity; 3) long-term: retrain refusal LM with int3-distilled tokens.

leo_prod: please open a release-blocker ticket for Dedicated/carveouts with a checklist: metrics threshold (jb_pass_rate <= 3.5%), required canary windows, and config pinning.

katy_mle: done — ticket #INC-3027, assigned to sam_infra and aj_safety. Repro steps and artifacts linked there.

aj_safety: I'll schedule a focused red-team run (manual) tomorrow morning; bring folks to triage if we get >5 high-severity outputs.

maria_eval: one more note — eval harness used our old toxicity classifier (v1). I'll re-run with v2 (stricter) to ensure we aren't undercounting. Could nudge numbers up.

katy_mle: thanks all — tagging @here for visibility. If anyone wants to run reproducer locally, use the debug command above and ping me for the quant blob.

sam_infra: acked. :thumbsup:
